React package usage

can run in a React application without . The core APIs remain available, but the React render-time State surface is supplied only by the React package.

React Integration

is a React integration wrapper around the core APIs. It preserves the core FluentApi, synchronous State Snapshot, and State Stream while adding useSyncExternalStore() as the React render-time State surface.

Call useSyncExternalStore() at the top level of a React function component. React owns the resulting subscription lifecycle and requests the latest Snapshot when State changes, so the component does not require a separate state$ subscription or manual subscription cleanup for its render path.

Initial State requires a render-time connection

A manual state$ subscription created after the has initialized can miss the emission that committed the initial State. Later State updates may still reach that subscription even though the initial render did not receive the current Snapshot.

useSyncExternalStore() gives the render the current Snapshot and connects it to subsequent State changes through the same render-time contract. Outside the render path, read state for the latest synchronous Snapshot or use state$ when an explicitly managed Observable subscription is required.

Installation

The React extension is available from the package on npm. 

{{`npm install @sdux-vault/react`}}

Download from npm →

React Component Pattern

Create and initialize the outside the component, then import its stable reference into the React component. During render, call useSyncExternalStore() once at the top level and render from the returned Snapshot. 

{{`import { FeatureCell, Vault } from '@sdux-vault/react';

Vault({
  logLevel: 'off',
  devMode: false
});

export const counterCell = FeatureCell<number>({
  key: 'counter',
  initialState: 0
});

counterCell.initialize();`}}
 
{{`import { counterCell } from './counter.cell';

export function CounterView() {
  const snapshot = counterCell.useSyncExternalStore();

  if (snapshot.isLoading) {
    return <p>Loading...</p>;
  }

  if (snapshot.error) {
    return <p role="alert">{snapshot.error.message}</p>;
  }

  if (!snapshot.hasValue) {
    return <p>No State is available.</p>;
  }

  return <p>Count: {snapshot.value}</p>;
}`}}
useSyncExternalStore()

useSyncExternalStore() connects the current React render to State and returns the latest committed immutable Snapshot. Its value, hasValue, isLoading, and error fields represent the State available to the current render.
